subject: 外國文（英文；包括作文、翻譯與應用文）
classes: 圖書資訊管理(選試英文)

essays.text: 英譯中：請將下列英文譯為中文。（25 分）Whatever their field, curators are responsible for the safety of the works in theirdepartment’s collection and the premises where they are housed. This entails an almostdaily round of maintenance visits with museum security chiefs: technical and logisticsheads, fire officers, and attendants working in the galleries and reserve collections. Thesevisits are accompanied by checks of the alarm systems, the showcases, the hung works,and the overall state of the displays.
英文應用文：（35 分）假設你是羅浮宮美術館館長 Jean-Luc Matinez，館方需要以 10 個月的時間維修勝利女神雕像（the Winged Victory of Samothrace），直到 2015 年 12 月 1 日才能重新開放參觀，此次維修工作主要是清洗雕像，整個過程會由國際專家組成的委員會監控。請為該館撰寫一封簡短的英文信函向遊客宣布此消息。
英文作文：請按照下列主題撰寫一篇約 200 字的英文作文。（40 分）On the Devaluation of Japanese Currency
